integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a wide shot frames a bare dance rehearsal studio across the fourteen-second take, sprung wooden floor, one mirrored wall, a single portable speaker on the floor by the mirror playing a fast, dry drum-machine pulse. A dancer in her twenties in a grey vest and loose black trousers stands centre frame, produces no vocal sound, and moves to the beat: sharp isolations of the shoulders and head on every hit, weight dropping into the knees on the downbeats, both arms snapping out and folding back in time. The camera holds a static shot as her footwork widens into a full-body groove that fills the frame. [Shot 2] At 00:06.316, the shot cuts to a medium shot from the mirror side, her reflection sharing the frame, as she turns on the beat and hits a pose, then breaks it into a rolling step sequence that lands on every fourth hit. Her lips stay closed throughout. The camera pushes in slowly at small amplitude as she stops square to the lens on a final hit and holds still, chest rising.

overall_soundscape: Bare feet squeak and slap on the sprung floor, fabric rustles with each turn, and her breath comes in short controlled bursts between hits, under the dry room tone of an empty studio.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, a medium close-up frames a woman in her thirties standing at the rail of a rooftop at dusk across the fourteen-second take, city lights soft and out of focus behind her, a light wind moving strands of her dark hair. She is on-screen, with a clear, measured mezzo (S1), and she looks straight into the lens and says, unhurried: <d>[English] It doesn't matter, Nicola Coughlan. None of this is real.</d> Her lips close and her jaw stops moving. She holds the look for a long beat, then turns her head slowly toward the city, her lips closed, and rests both forearms on the rail. The camera holds a static shot as the wind lifts her hair and the lights behind her drift slightly with the shallow focus.

overall_soundscape: A steady wind moves across the rooftop with faint distant traffic far below, a flag rope ticks against a pole somewhere off frame, and her coat fabric rustles as she turns.
